findings.desc: done_closure now classifies done-required-validation as a done_prepare recovery blocker and returns only lattice done_prepare as the nextCommand, but done_prepare never invokes the separate done_required_validate writer. Its validate step calls ordinary lattice validate, then rebuilds done_closure; missing or stale done-required-evidence.json is produced only by done_required_validate. For opted-in doneRequiredCommands this routes the operator into a loop instead of creating post-merge material/storyFilesHash-bound DONE-required evidence, so the ordering-sensitive blocker is not actually recovered by the host-neutral command.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 42929151: done_prepare now invokes the existing done_required_validate handler whenever validate=true and doneRequiredCommands are configured, then fails closed on FAIL output. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build and node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-smoke.js, including missing DONE-required evidence is produced by done_prepare validation.

findings.desc: Test coverage does not prove the new done_prepare recovery path actually resolves missing DONE-required evidence. The new smoke scenario only builds the DONE checklist/runbook and asserts branch-synced-main plus done-required-validation nextCommand values point at lattice done_prepare; it never executes done_prepare for that missing evidence case. Existing DONE-required smoke pre-runs done_required_validate before done_prepare, so it only covers already-present evidence. Meanwhile done_closure maps done-required-validation to done_prepare, but done_prepare only runs ordinary lattice validate before rebuilding done_closure and does not invoke done_required_validate. A missing DONE-required blocker can therefore be routed to a command that rechecks and blocks again, and the current regression coverage would not catch the stale/DONE recovery loop.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 42929151: done-prepare-smoke now executes done_prepare with missing DONE-required evidence, asserts PASS done-required-evidence.json is written through the existing validator, and asserts failing DONE-required validation blocks at validate with FAIL evidence. Verified by node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-smoke.js.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-readiness.ts:509 still maps DONE evidence-freshness to lattice validate, done-required-validation to done_required_validate, and branch-synced-main to git merge main. The local branch CLI verifies this public runbook mismatch: node packages/main/dist/cli.js lifecycle_check --storyId=B-c1b1 --target=DONE --format=json emits those old nextCommand values, while node packages/main/dist/cli.js done_closure --storyId=B-c1b1 --format=json emits lattice done_prepare for the same blocker ids. This leaves lifecycle_check users on the ordering-sensitive recovery path that this story is meant to replace and can reintroduce stale evidence after main sync. Update lifecycle-readiness and coverage so exact DONE recovery blocker mapping is consistent across diagnostics.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 42929151: lifecycle-readiness DONE nextCommand mapping now routes evidence-freshness, done-required-validation, and branch-synced-main to the same done_prepare command as done_closure, while unrelated blockers keep existing commands. Verified by done-prepare-smoke lifecycle_check maps stale DONE evidence freshness to done_prepare and DONE recovery hints route ordering-sensitive blockers through done_prepare.

findings.desc: lifecycle_check smoke remains stale after DONE-required recovery remap: npm run test:lifecycle-check-smoke fails at packages/main/src/tasks/lifecycle-check-smoke.ts:362-365 with AssertionError "next actions include DONE-required guidance". The implementation now routes done-required-validation blockers through lattice done_prepare, matching done_closure, but the smoke still only accepts done_required_validate or a reason containing missing_done_required_validation, leaving the smoke suite red.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 85bdb42: lifecycle-check-smoke now expects DONE-required recovery next actions to route through lattice done_prepare while preserving the missing_done_required_validation readiness classification. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:lifecycle-check-smoke, node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-smoke.js, git diff --check, and full lattice validate --story=B-c1b1 --json passing 26 configured commands.
